description: This Java class 'MakeInString' is a container for operations that generate a new input string by combining various operations such as in-field, property, and constant operations. It constructs the string based on a list of operations and updates the input map with the resulting string.

classes.name: MakeInString
classes.description: A class that constructs a string from multiple operations and assigns it to a specified field in a map.

methods.name: MakeInString
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object by parsing an XML element to determine the operations to perform.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the list of operations to build a string and stores it in the input map under the specified field name.
